description: 阿拉伯杀：精彩弃后，引王出角，车将军逼回，Rg8#将死
explanation_en: White sacrifices the queen to draw the king out, checks it back with the rook, and finishes with Rg8# and a rook-knight Arabian mate.

intro.popup: 💡 阿拉伯杀：精彩的弃后攻杀！先弃后引王出角，再用车将军驱王，最后完成阿拉伯杀。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Arabian mate: A striking queen sacrifice draws the king out of the corner. Use rook checks to drive it back, then complete the mating pattern.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：精彩的弃后攻杀。Qxf8+引王，Re8+驱王，Rg8#完成阿拉伯杀，车马配合的威力。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qxf8+ lures the king out, Re8+ drives it back, and Rg8# completes Arabian mate. The rook and knight work together to seal the king in.

moves.popup: 白后弃后Qxf8+！将军，引诱黑王来吃。
moves.popup_en: Qxf8+! White sacrifices the queen with check, tempting the black king to capture it.
Kxf8. The black king captures the queen and is drawn away from its original square.
Re8+! The rook checks and forces the black king back to g7.
The black king is forced to Kg7, returning to its original square.

moves.popup: 白车Rg8#，阿拉伯杀！马封逃格，车将死黑王。
moves.popup_en: Rg8# delivers Arabian mate! The knight covers the escape squares while the rook gives checkmate.
